# The shared form-picker helper has missing assertion messages

The accepted checkABrowser helper has 17 Assert.equal calls without a message in its select/autocomplete checks. These existing diagnostics are separate from the one-line picker-button port and should state the expected value or option when maintained under current assertion guidance. No helper assertion was changed or executed by this study.

Scope: Shared browser form-picker harness.
